import bpy, math
from mathutils import Vector
bpy.ops.wm.read_factory_settings(use_empty=True)

def material(name, color, metallic=0.0, roughness=0.5):
    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.diffuse_color = (*color, 1)
    m.use_nodes = True
    p = m.node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF')
    p.inputs['Base Color'].default_value = (*color, 1)
    p.inputs['Metallic'].default_value = metallic
    p.inputs['Roughness'].default_value = roughness
    return m

def wood(name, color):
    m = material(name, color, roughness=0.57)
    n, l = m.node_tree.nodes, m.node_tree.links
    tex = n.new('ShaderNodeTexNoise')
    tex.inputs['Scale'].default_value = 4
    tex.inputs['Detail'].default_value = 3
    coord = n.new('ShaderNodeTexCoord')
    mapping = n.new('ShaderNodeVectorMath')
    mapping.operation = 'MULTIPLY'
    mapping.inputs[1].default_value = (1.8, 65, 65)
    l.new(coord.outputs['Generated'], mapping.inputs[0])
    l.new(mapping.outputs['Vector'], tex.inputs['Vector'])
    ramp = n.new('ShaderNodeValToRGB')
    ramp.color_ramp.elements[0].position = 0.18
    ramp.color_ramp.elements[0].color = (*[c * 0.65 for c in color], 1)
    ramp.color_ramp.elements[1].position = 0.85
    ramp.color_ramp.elements[1].color = (*[min(c * 1.25, 1) for c in color], 1)
    l.new(tex.outputs['Fac'], ramp.inputs[0])
    l.new(ramp.outputs['Color'], n.get('Principled BSDF').inputs['Base Color'])
    bump = n.new('ShaderNodeBump')
    bump.inputs['Strength'].default_value = 0.13
    bump.inputs['Distance'].default_value = 0.002
    l.new(tex.outputs['Fac'], bump.inputs['Height'])
    l.new(bump.outputs['Normal'], n.get('Principled BSDF').inputs['Normal'])
    return m

def box(name, loc, size, mat, bevel=0.008):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=loc)
    o = bpy.context.object
    o.name = name
    o.dimensions = size
    bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(location=False, rotation=False, scale=True)
    o.data.materials.append(mat)
    if bevel:
        b = o.modifiers.new('Soft manufactured edges', 'BEVEL')
        b.width = bevel
        b.segments = 3
        o.modifiers.new('Weighted corner normals', 'WEIGHTED_NORMAL')
    return o

def beam(name, a, b, width, depth, mat):
    a, b = Vector(a), Vector(b)
    o = box(name, (a + b) / 2, (width, depth, (b-a).length), mat)
    o.rotation_euler = (b-a).to_track_quat('Z', 'Y').to_euler()
    return o

def cylinder(name, loc, radius, depth, mat, axis=(0,0,1), vertices=32):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=vertices, radius=radius, depth=depth, location=loc)
    o = bpy.context.object
    o.name = name
    o.rotation_euler = Vector(axis).to_track_quat('Z', 'Y').to_euler()
    o.data.materials.append(mat)
    bevel = o.modifiers.new('Edge glint', 'BEVEL')
    bevel.width = 0.0015
    bevel.segments = 2
    o.modifiers.new('Weighted normals', 'WEIGHTED_NORMAL')
    return o

import bpy, math
from mathutils import Vector
bpy.ops.wm.read_factory_settings(use_empty=True)

def mat(name, color, metallic=0, roughness=0.45):
    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.diffuse_color = (*color,1)
    m.use_nodes = True
    p = m.node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF')
    p.inputs['Base Color'].default_value = (*color,1)
    p.inputs['Metallic'].default_value = metallic
    p.inputs['Roughness'].default_value = roughness
    return m

def box(name, loc, size, material, bevel=0.015):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=loc)
    o = bpy.context.object
    o.name = name
    o.dimensions = size
    bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(location=False, rotation=False, scale=True)
    o.data.materials.append(material)
    if bevel:
        m = o.modifiers.new('Rounded edges','BEVEL')
        m.width = bevel
        m.segments = 3
        o.modifiers.new('Weighted normals','WEIGHTED_NORMAL')
    return o

def beam(name, a, b, width, depth, material):
    a,b = Vector(a),Vector(b)
    o = box(name,(a+b)/2,(width,depth,(b-a).length),material)
    o.rotation_euler = (b-a).to_track_quat('Z','Y').to_euler()
    return o

def tube(name, points, radius, material, cyclic=False):
    c = bpy.data.curves.new(name,'CURVE')
    c.dimensions = '3D'
    c.resolution_u = 1
    c.bevel_depth = radius
    c.bevel_resolution = 3
    s = c.splines.new('POLY')
    s.points.add(len(points)-1)
    for p,co in zip(s.points,points):
        p.co = (*co,1)
    s.use_cyclic_u = cyclic
    o = bpy.data.objects.new(name,c)
    bpy.context.collection.objects.link(o)
    c.materials.append(material)
    return o

def cyl(name, loc, radius, depth, material, vertices=32, axis=(0,0,1)):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=vertices,radius=radius,depth=depth,location=loc)
    o = bpy.context.object
    o.name = name
    o.rotation_euler = Vector(axis).to_track_quat('Z','Y').to_euler()
    o.data.materials.append(material)
    return o

import bpy, math
from mathutils import Vector
bpy.ops.wm.read_factory_settings(use_empty=True)

def mat(name,color,metallic=0,roughness=0.65):
    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.diffuse_color = (*color,1)
    m.use_nodes = True
    p = m.node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF')
    p.inputs['Base Color'].default_value = (*color,1)
    p.inputs['Metallic'].default_value = metallic
    p.inputs['Roughness'].default_value = roughness
    return m

def box(name,loc,size,material,bevel=0):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1,location=loc)
    o = bpy.context.object
    o.name = name
    o.dimensions = size
    bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(location=False,rotation=False,scale=True)
    o.data.materials.append(material)
    if bevel:
        b = o.modifiers.new('Edge rounding','BEVEL')
        b.width = bevel
        b.segments = 2
        o.modifiers.new('Weighted normals','WEIGHTED_NORMAL')
    return o

def paths(name,lines,radius,material):
    c = bpy.data.curves.new(name,'CURVE')
    c.dimensions = '3D'
    c.bevel_depth = radius
    c.bevel_resolution = 1
    for points in lines:
        s = c.splines.new('POLY')
        s.points.add(len(points)-1)
        for p,co in zip(s.points,points):
            p.co = (*co,1)
    o = bpy.data.objects.new(name,c)
    bpy.context.collection.objects.link(o)
    c.materials.append(material)
    return o

def pole(name,a,b,radius,material,vertices=20):
    a,b = Vector(a),Vector(b)
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=vertices,radius=radius,depth=(b-a).length,location=(a+b)/2)
    o = bpy.context.object
    o.name = name
    o.rotation_euler = (b-a).to_track_quat('Z','Y').to_euler()
    o.data.materials.append(material)
    for p in o.data.polygons:
        p.use_smooth = True
    return o

    return 0.914+0.156*(abs(x)/net_half)**2

columns = 256
for i in range(columns+1):
    x = -net_half+2*net_half*i/columns
    lines.append([(x,0,0.06),(x,0,top(x)-0.025)])

    f = j/18
    lines.append([(-net_half+2*net_half*i/128,0,0.06+f*(top(-net_half+2*net_half*i/128)-0.085)) for i in range(129)])

    if i:
        a = 2*(i-1)
        faces.append((a,a+2,a+3,a+1))

        ya = -yedge + 2*yedge*i/12
        yb = -yedge + 2*yedge*(i+1)/12

        if side == 1 and i == 5:
            continue
        segments.append(((side*xedge,ya),(side*xedge,yb)))
    for i in range(6):
        xa = -xedge+2*xedge*i/6
        xb = -xedge+2*xedge*(i+1)/6
        segments.append(((xa,side*yedge),(xb,side*yedge)))
post_coords = set()
fence_lines = []
for a,b in segments:
    post_coords.add(a)

# Eight independently colored, curved canopy gores with scalloped valances.
def umbrella(cx,cy,index):
    radius,peak = 1.43,2.73
    cylinder('Beech umbrella mast',(cx,cy,1.37),0.027,2.75,wood)
    cylinder('Sliding rib hub',(cx,cy,2.12),0.064,0.105,ribmat)
    def canopy_point(r,t):
        return (cx+r*math.cos(t),cy+r*math.sin(t),peak-0.57*(r/radius)**0.72)
    for sector in range(8):
        a0 = sector*math.tau/8
        material = colors[index] if sector%2==0 else cream
        verts = [(cx,cy,peak)]
        faces = []
        nr,nt = 10,8
        for j in range(1,nr+1):
            r = radius*j/nr
            for k in range(nt+1):
                t = a0+math.tau/8*k/nt
                x,y,z = canopy_point(r,t)
                z -= 0.038*math.sin(math.pi*k/nt)*(r/radius)**1.6
                verts.append((x,y,z))
        for k in range(nt):
            faces.append((0,1+k,2+k))
        for j in range(nr-1):
            a = 1+j*(nt+1)
            b = a+nt+1
            for k in range(nt):
                faces.append((a+k,b+k,b+k+1,a+k+1))
        edge = 1+(nr-1)*(nt+1)
        lower = len(verts)
        for k in range(nt+1):
            x,y,z = verts[edge+k]
            verts.append((x,y,z-0.075-0.075*math.sin(math.pi*k/nt)))
        for k in range(nt):
            faces.append((edge+k,lower+k,lower+k+1,edge+k+1))
        mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new('Curved canopy panel mesh')
        mesh.from_pydata(verts,[],faces)
        mesh.update()
        o = bpy.data.objects.new('Umbrella %d panel %d' % (index+1,sector+1),mesh)
        bpy.context.collection.objects.link(o)
        o.data.materials.append(material)
        for f in mesh.polygons:
            f.use_smooth = True
        s = o.modifiers.new('Canvas thickness','SOLIDIFY')
        s.thickness = 0.002
        seam = [canopy_point(radius*j/20,a0) for j in range(21)]
        tube('Canopy stitched seam',seam,0.004,cream)
        tube('Underside radial rib',[(x,y,z-0.014) for x,y,z in seam],0.007,ribmat)
        x,y,z = canopy_point(radius*0.55,a0)
        tube('Rib supporting strut',[(cx,cy,2.12),(x,y,z-0.025)],0.007,ribmat)
        tube('Scalloped canopy hem',verts[lower:lower+nt+1],0.004,cream)
    cylinder('Top finial',(cx,cy,peak+0.046),0.046,0.10,wood)

def lounge(cx,cy,angle,index):
    def p(x,y,z):
        return (cx+x*math.cos(angle)-y*math.sin(angle),cy+x*math.sin(angle)+y*math.cos(angle),z)
    profile = [(-1.0,0.32),(-0.72,0.36),(0.20,0.38),(0.47,0.60),(0.88,1.08)]
    for side in (-1,1):
        tube('Lounge side rail',[p(side*0.34,y,z) for y,z in profile],0.022,frame)
        tube('Folding front leg',[p(side*0.30,-0.75,0.02),p(side*0.31,-0.55,0.35),p(side*0.31,0.10,0.10)],0.019,frame)
        tube('Folding rear leg',[p(side*0.30,0.73,0.025),p(side*0.31,0.35,0.52),p(side*0.31,-0.25,0.10)],0.019,frame)
        tube('Backrest adjustment stay',[p(side*0.32,0.70,0.16),p(side*0.32,0.66,0.82)],0.014,frame)
        for yy in (-0.75,0.73):

    for y,z in (profile[0],profile[2],profile[-1]):

    for j in range(8):

        vertices = []
        for y,z in profile:
            vertices.extend([p(xa,y,z+0.006),p(xb,y,z+0.006)])
        faces = [(2*k,2*k+1,2*k+3,2*k+2) for k in range(len(profile)-1)]
        mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new('Striped sling mesh')
        mesh.from_pydata(vertices,[],faces)

        o = bpy.data.objects.new('Lounge canvas stripe',mesh)

        o.data.materials.append(cream if j%2==0 else colors[index])

    y,z = 0.745,0.94
    pillow = box('Padded head cushion',p(0,y-0.028,z+0.035),(0.48,0.22,0.075),cream,0.032)
